newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli army raids villages, arrests Hamas members.
newsitem.headline: Israeli army raids villages, arrests Hamas members.

text.p: Israeli security forces raided several West Bank villages and arrested Hamas activists and their families on Thursday following a deadly suicide attack in a Jewish market in Jerusalem, relatives said on Thursday.

They said Israeli soldiers stormed into Dahariyeh village near the West Bank city of Hebron and arrested nine members of two families whose sons, both Islamic militants, have been missing for 15 months.
Two suicide bombers blew themselves up seconds apart in the market on Wednesday, killing 13 people. A leaflet issued in the name of the Islamic Hamas movement claimed responsibility for the attack.
All arrests and raids were carried out in Palestinian villages still under Israeli occupation.

In the Jenin area, in the north of the West Bank, soldiers arrested two activists belonging to Hamas. As it happened, residents said Israel freed eight Islamic militants whose jail terms ended on Thursday.
In Qossin village near Nablus, the army arrested 15 Palestinians from one family early on Thursday but later released 10 of them.
Israel sealed off the West Bank and Gaza Strip and confined Palestinians to their cities and villages following the bombings.
Hamas, opposed to the PLO-Israel peace deals, has carried out suicide bombings in Israel killing scores of people since the accords were implemented in 1994.

"The closures and Israel's measures are a collective, punitive measure which give new ammunition to those who want to resort ot violence and it is an indication that Israel still behaves as an occupier," said Palestinian Higher Education Minister Hanan Ashrawi.
